decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already applies the identical minute right-arm length increase to the second V while preserving its Option B terminal geometry, taper, point shape, and profile.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the mechanical same-line length increase, its cross-form application, and all required geometry invariants.
A complete same-message MODIFY already applies the proportional length adjustment to the É accent and preserves the Option B terminal constraints.
A complete same-message MODIFY already separates the unchanged Option B terminal baseline from the optional corner-softening comparison and isolates terminal treatment from arm length.
The source locks the surrounding architecture and changes only the three signature forms' right-arm length; it does not alter the proprietary E and L letterform requirements.
The source explicitly preserves spacing, proportions, and overall architecture, so the selected Balanced Flow composition and hierarchy remain valid unchanged.
The mechanical clarification of right-arm length does not change the established brand character, emotional goals, or Hero V symbolism.
The source states that the finish remains locked and makes no change to the champagne-gold finish or distribution requirements.
A minute geometry refinement to the signature forms does not change the wordmark-led identity or the prohibition on requiring a separate icon or monogram.
The source concerns a design comparison and does not change the final production-ready asset deliverable.
